description: OCR PDF online: make a scanned PDF searchable, with text you can select and copy. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The scanned PDF, base64-encoded (up to 20 MB of PDF). One page is read per call; the response carries the PDF with that page made searchable and `remaining`, the pages still to read. Send that PDF back with the next call until `remaining` is empty. Send this or image, not both.

image.description: Instead of data: one page already rendered to an image, base64 in the format given by type. Returns the lines read and where each sits, without a PDF.

language.description: The language the page is most likely in, e.g. 'Danish', as a hint to the model. Not a constraint: what is on the page is transcribed.

name.description: The file name to base the returned PDF's name on. Only used with data.

page.description: Which page of data to read, counted from 1. Omit to read the first page that has no text layer yet. A page that already has text is refused without charge, since reading it would add a second copy of every word.

type.description: The MIME type of image: image/jpeg, image/png or image/webp. Ignored with data.

name: ocr_pdf
title: OCR PDF
